name: finclose
description: Prepares your books for your accountant, on your own computer. Read-only: it proposes and decides nothing.

tools.name: finclose_connect
tools.description: Sign in to Xero or Zoho Books on this computer (read access).

tools.name: finclose_review_books
tools.description: Read the books for a period and return proposals for the accountant. Read-only.

partner_id.title: Partner id
partner_id.description: Given to you by your accountant or FinClose partner.

partner_code.title: Partner code
partner_code.description: The code your partner received from FinClose.

company_country.title: Company country
company_country.description: Two-letter code, like EE, GB or US.

smartaccounts_apikey.title: SmartAccounts API key
smartaccounts_apikey.description: Only if you use SmartAccounts. Create a read-only key there. Stays on this computer.

smartaccounts_secret.title: SmartAccounts secret key
smartaccounts_secret.description: Only if you use SmartAccounts. Stays on this computer.

xero_client_id.title: Xero app client id
xero_client_id.description: Only if you use Xero. Provided by your partner (a public id, not a secret).

zoho_client_id.title: Zoho app client id
zoho_client_id.description: Only if you use Zoho Books. Provided by your partner (a public id, not a secret).
